note: Latin-script Manipuri agricultural terms. Every form is attested in CompiledDataEnglishToMeitei.xlsx; the evidence rows are quoted verbatim. Which word in a sentence matches the English term was read off the sentence pairs (co-occurrence across many rows, then checked row by row); that alignment is what a fluent speaker must confirm before verified_by/verified_on are filled. Terms not attested in the dataset are left out and listed in MEMBER_A_README.md. cue_words are question and reference words (why, how, which, where, first, this, here, high, very, is) with the same evidence; the router (satquery/agent/language.py) reads terms and cue words as concepts to recognise the intent of a Latin Manipuri question. An optional 'concept' field overrides the concept a term's category implies.
